cohort: The study was conducted on 87 high-risk pregnant women admitted to the labor ward.
finding: Non-reactive Non-Stress Tests (NSTs) on admission in high-risk pregnancies are significantly associated with a higher incidence of adverse perinatal outcomes, including increased rates of cesarean delivery, low APGAR scores, NICU admission, prolonged NICU stay, and early neonatal deaths.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly higher in the non-reactive NST group (82.1%) compared to the reactive NST group (30.5%).
followup_time: Up to 7 days post-birth (for early neonatal deaths)
